import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { employees } from "../../../backend/schema/employees";

export const employeesCms = customizeTable<typeof employees>("employees", {
    display: {
        title: "lastName"
    },
    listFields: ["employeeId", "title", "titleOfCourtesy", "firstName", "lastName", "address"],
    fields: {
        notes: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "employeeId",
        "title",
        "titleOfCourtesy",
        "firstName",
        "lastName",
        "address",
        "city",
        "region",
        "postalCode",
        "country",
        "homePhone",
        "extension",
        "birthDate",
        "hireDate",
        "reportsToRelation",
        "notes",
        "photo",
        "photoPath"
    ]
});
